marco_release: Scheduling Orchid Biomed private rollout for 2026-02-15 01:30 UTC (proposed). Plan: canary 01:30-01:50 (5%), ramp to 50% 01:50-02:00, full cutover by 02:05. Want to pin model to rwinf-1.4.2-quant and perform KMS key rotation later in the window. Need quick approvals + rollback criteria.
anna_ops: Quick Q — Orchid mentioned a DB maintenance window 02:30-03:00 UTC. Are we overlapping them?
lynne_sre: Heads up: infra has a scheduled KMS rotation in eu-west-1 at 02:10-02:20 UTC today. That collides with the original plan if we go later. We should avoid doing key rotations and cutovers at the same time.
raj_dev: Model pin is fine. Recommend avoiding KMS changes during cutover. Fallback plan: route to rwinf-1.3.9 (stable) if error_rate > 2% or latency spikes. Also suggest canary at 5% for 20m then 50% for 10m.
marco_release: Agreed — let's not mix risky ops. New proposal: move main rollout earlier to start 01:30 UTC (canary 01:30-01:50), ramp to 50% 01:50-02:00, full at ~02:05. KMS rotation to be delayed until after 02:50. Approvals?
lynne_sre: Gate thresholds proposed (we'll auto-rollback if any trigger):
```
- error_rate > 2% (5m window) -> rollback to rwinf-1.3.9
- p50_latency > 600ms (5m) -> pause and inspect
- p95_latency > 1.2s OR p95 increases >30% vs baseline -> pause and alert
- autoscaler: >3 node flaps in 10m -> pause and paging
```
deploybot: deploybot: starting canary for orchid-biomed on rwinf-1.4.2-quant (slice s-42) — target 5% traffic. canary_id=cb-3790012345
anna_ops: Monitoring dashboards and tracing hooks live. I'll add the release note snippet: "private: rwinf-1.4.2-quant — quantized kernels, KV-cache adjustments, minor schema-safe change"
deploybot: canary metrics 10m: error_rate 0.3%, p50 180ms, p95 420ms — healthy :white_check_mark:
raj_dev: Looks good. If green, I'll approve ramp to 50% at 01:50. Also will temporarily set `kms.rotate=false` on the deployment config during the cutover.
lynne_sre: I'm confirming with infra — I can delay the platform KMS rotation by ~40m. Will update once they ack.
deploybot: canary ramp to 50% complete. metrics stable. canary_id=cb-3790012345
marco_release: Green to proceed with staged ramp. Infra has agreed to hold KMS rotate until 02:50. Final rollback plan: immediate traffic shift back to dedicated-stable (rwinf-1.3.9) + restore previous routing config. Ops runbook: if rollback -> revert route, clear KV caches, notify customer.
anna_ops: Publishing release notes + sending customer ping now: "Orchid: scheduled rollout 01:30-02:50 UTC. Expect brief transient retries; we'll monitor and follow up"
lynne_sre: @deploybot please enforce autoscale pause rule: if >3 flaps in 10m, pause and page SRE.
deploybot: FULL RAMP: completed at 02:05 UTC. final metrics: error_rate 0.4%, p50 200ms, p95 480ms. No gates tripped.
raj_dev: Thanks team — closing the change window and tagging the release. :thumbsup:
marco_release: Noting: pinned model rwinf-1.4.2-quant for Orchid Biomed, KMS rotation deferred to 02:50, rollback thresholds documented in runbook. Good job.
